Write a failing test suite for commit-override.sh before the implementation exists.

## Test file
tests/scripts/test-commit-override.sh (CREATE)

## Test cases (all must FAIL until T3 is implemented)
1. test_requires_reason_flag — exits 1 when --reason not passed
2. test_non_interactive_blocked — exits 1 when stdin not a TTY and DSO_FORCE_INTERACTIVE is unset
3. test_force_interactive_bypass — exits 0 when DSO_FORCE_INTERACTIVE=1 (TTY check bypassed)
4. test_autonomous_mode_blocked — exits 1 when DSO_FBKY_AUTONOMOUS_MODE is set (any non-empty value)
5. test_writes_override_token — with DSO_FORCE_INTERACTIVE=1 and valid --reason, creates $ARTIFACTS_DIR/override.token as valid JSON containing diff_hash, reason, timestamp, attribution fields
6. test_appends_to_log — with DSO_FORCE_INTERACTIVE=1 and valid --reason, appends a JSON Lines entry to $ARTIFACTS_DIR/commit-overrides.log
7. test_token_overwrite_if_exists — when override.token already exists, a second invocation overwrites it (last-writer-wins)

## Classification
RED — all tests must fail before implementation

## TDD requirement
Commit these tests using the .test-index RED marker protocol. Tests must fail (exit non-zero) at commit time.

- tests/scripts/test-commit-override.sh (CREATE)
